description: Search French medicines in the BDPM by the start of their name and/or by an active substance, returning matching specialties (CIS code, denomination, holder, pharmaceutical form, marketing status). Use for "medicines containing paracetamol", "search Doliprane", or finding a CIS code to pass to fr_medicine. Prefix match only ("DOLIPRANE" finds "DOLIPRANE 1000 mg..." but not "CODOLIPRANE"); pass both name and substance to intersect.

name.description: Start of the medicine's official denomination, e.g. "DOLIPRANE".

substance.description: Start of an active substance name, e.g. "PARACETAMOL".

name: fr_medicine_search
title: Fr Medicine Search
